title: Daydream Believer Vacation Rental
meta_description: Daydream Believer is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 12)- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Dual Washers & Dryers- Third Floor Terrace- Private Carriage House- Large Screened In Porches with Ping Pong Table- Exterior Shower- Gas Grill- Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available)- 4 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside- 2 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club Access DETAILS:Welcome to Daydream Believer at 86 Sunset Ridge Lane—a stunning and newly updated retreat nestled beneath a canopy of majestic oak trees in the heart of WaterColor. Perfectly situated on the peaceful and picturesque Crimson Park, this beautifully designed home is just steps away from the WaterColor Beach Club and offers the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience.Spanning three levels and featuring a private carriage house, this spacious home was made for gathering, relaxing, and making lasting memories. Inside, you're greeted by a grand staircase, wide-plank shiplap walls, and oversized windows that flood the space with natural light. The open floor plan flows effortlessly between thoughtfully curated indoor and outdoor living areas, including expansive wraparound porches. The first floor is tailored for comfort and functionality, featuring two guest bedrooms, each with a private en-suite bathroom. One is a fun and functional bunk room with a twin-over-full and a twin-over-twin configuration, sleeping up to five guests comfortably. The second bedroom is a king suite, complete with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. This level also includes a large laundry room with dual washers and dryers, as well as access to a spacious screened-in porch and outdoor patio, ideal for al fresco dining or evening conversations under the stars. Upstairs, the second floor is the true heart of the home. The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together seamlessly, making it easy to connect with family and friends. The beautifully equipped kitchen opens onto a porch overlooking the park, while a separate powder room adds extra convenience. Also on this level is a serene king bedroom and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo, offering a peaceful and comfortable retreat. Continue up to the third floor, where you'll discover a delightful treetop tower featuring an open-air terrace perfect for rooftop viewing and private sunbathing, complemented by a peaceful indoor retreat ideal for quiet contemplation or relaxation. (*Peloton not available for guest use.) For those seeking additional privacy or accommodation for extended family and friends, the property includes a charming carriage house that provides a fully self-contained living space, featuring custom-designed built-in bunk beds, a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a convenient kitchenette. As a WaterColor guest, you'll enjoy full access to all of WaterColor’s premier amenities, including the exclusive Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, the Boathouse, and three additional community pools. Explore the area with ease using the four adult bikes included in your stay. With nearby walking and biking trails, premium shopping, local dining, and just a quick ride to Seaside, this home offers the ultimate 30A experience. From the thoughtful design to the unbeatable location, Daydream Believer is a true WaterColor gem. Let the experienced team at Sanders Beach Rentals transform your next vacation into an unforgettable experience that you and your loved ones will cherish for years to come.
